data.title: NWC Launches 'Virtual Service Center' Campaign to Strengthen its Digital Channels
data.content: Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The National Water Company (NWC) has launched an awareness campaign for the "Virtual Service Center," one of its initiatives aimed at improving customer communication channels and offering an easier, more flexible digital service experience through direct video communication with customer service staff, from 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., Sunday through Thursday. The Virtual Service Center allows customers to communicate with service representatives via video call, with the option of sharing documents and their screen when needed. This helps simplify service procedures, handle requests and inquiries more effectively, and raise customer satisfaction. The service targets the company's customers as well as deaf and hearing-impaired individuals and prospective customers, which enhances the inclusiveness of communication channels and makes the service available at an equal and accessible level for all beneficiary groups. The launch of the Virtual Service Center continues the company's efforts to develop its service system and expand its digital channels, so that customers enjoy an integrated experience that saves time and effort and ensures their transactions are completed quickly. NWC urges its customers to use the center's services through its official channels: its mobile app for smartphones or its e-branch: https://ebranch.nwc.com.sa/login. -- SPA 11:11 Local Time 08:11 GMT 0015
